parameters.jsCode: const x=$json.body??$json; const rows=Array.isArray(x.rows)?x.rows:[]; const seen=new Set(); const duplicates=new Set(); for(const r of rows){const sku=String(r.sku??r.product_code??'').trim();if(sku&&seen.has(sku))duplicates.add(sku);if(sku)seen.add(sku);} const items=rows.map((r,i)=>{const sku=String(r.sku??r.product_code??'').trim();const price=Number(r.unit_price??r.price);const issues=[];if(!sku)issues.push('missing_sku');if(!String(r.description??'').trim())issues.push('missing_description');if(!String(r.unit??'').trim())issues.push('missing_unit');if(!Number.isFinite(price)||price<0)issues.push('invalid_price');if(duplicates.has(sku))issues.push('duplicate_sku');return {row:i+1,sku,description:String(r.description??'').trim(),unit:String(r.unit??'').trim(),price:Number.isFinite(price)?price:null,currency:String(r.currency??'GBP'),vat_basis:String(r.vat_basis??'unknown'),issues,accepted:issues.length===0};});return [{json:{supplier:String(x.supplier??'unspecified'),summary:{received:rows.length,accepted:items.filter(i=>i.accepted).length,rejected:items.filter(i=>!i.accepted).length},items,import_to_live_price_book:false,human_review_required:true,source_prices_must_be_verified:true}}];
